# 1 Chronicles 11 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 1 Chronicles 11 (47 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 4

---

## V.1 — "bone and flesh" vs. "flesh and blood"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "your bone and your flesh" / **PNEUMA:** "your own flesh and blood"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "your bone and your flesh" — preserves the Hebrew merism's specific word order.

---

## V.5 — Jebusite taunt register
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "You will not come in here" / **PNEUMA:** "You'll never get in here!"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "You will not come in here" — terse, matching the Hebrew tone.

---

## V.17 — David's longing expression
- **EMET:** "Who will give me drink" / **LOGOS:** "Oh, that someone would" / **PNEUMA:** "If only someone could"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Oh, that someone would give me water to drink" — captures the optative Hebrew construction.

---

## V.22 — ari'el rendering
- **EMET:** "Ari'el of Mo'av" / **LOGOS:** "heroes of Moab" / **PNEUMA:** "mightiest champions"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "heroes of Moab" — safest rendering of an uncertain term.

---
*— SOPHIA*
